_about: Public-domain Henry Sacheverell, High Church preacher impeached in 1710, for the Word Hoard: his own sermons, including The Perils of False Brethren, The Political Union and The Character of a Low-Church-Man, his answer and speech at his impeachment, and his later sermons. Pamphlets by others about his trial are left out. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 120 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
